name: How can I get rid of a moldy smell under my kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: How can I get rid of a moldy smell under my kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get rid of a moldy smell, first locate and fix any moisture source, such as a leaky pipe or dripping faucet. Thoroughly clean the affected area with a mold-killing solution like a bleach and water mixture (1 cup bleach to 1 gallon water) or a commercial mold remover. Ensure the area is completely dried after cleaning. Improve ventilation, and consider using a dehumidifier if humidity is high. For extensive growth or if the smell persists, professional mold remediation may be necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fix moisture sources, clean the area with a mold-killing solution, dry thoroughly, improve ventilation, and consider professional help if the smell persists.
